891-3899-8207.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-7201-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

849-2738-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-5478-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-5478-6441-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2523-2869-4905.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Fanatical Firebrand that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Repeat using the Fanatical Firebrand token

1061-1576-7638.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-7638.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-7638.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-4559-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-4559-5147-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

176-3000-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-3000-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

2034-4766-6990.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1978-3784-5143.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat

3094-3649-5940.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3094-3649-5940.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform's Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

5113-5220-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
Realmwalker has a creture type chosen that is found on the nontoken artifact creature.
5113-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1430-2232-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
1430-2232-6749.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Mirror Image enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mirror Image from the battlefield to your hand.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Mirror Image from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3330-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3330-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-6702-6723.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-2770-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2511-2770-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

56-4054-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

4094-4508-4875-5880.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control another nonland permanent.
4094-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-4210-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4210-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3558-3967-5220-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crookshank Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2653-3519-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2653-3519-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {1} for each Forest Dryad.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling the Forest Dryads.

2576-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
2576-3957-4613.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Famished Paladin using Temple Elder's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2080-4050-4125.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-4050-4125.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2438-3327-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2438-3327-4871.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
When Dargo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1283-1651-2645-2774.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Depth-Charge Colossus and Staff of Domination, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Depth-Charge Colossus by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1908-1947-3750.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least two instants and/or sorceries this turn.
1908-1947-3750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least three copies of Reckless Barbarian with haste.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate three Reckless Barbarian tokens by sacrificing them, adding six {R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untap all attacking creatures and getting an additional combat phase and main phase after this phase.
Repeat.

2522-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
2522-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid for {3}{G} targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the target and copying Chain of Acid targeting the same permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

151-4241-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-4241-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-4241-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.
